replies.body:

Great map! +1

replies.author: OldManTigerMask
replies.body:
Great Map! 

What this map has on my Map Criteria:
[✓] Detail
[✓] Room for building & Fighting
[✓] Layers & Structures
[✓] YML
[✓] Etiquette Kit
[✓] Accessibility 
[✘] Sufficient Iron
[✘] Lag Free

Tips:
The Iron is Sufficient however I don't particularly having it surrounded with prismarine blocks, I suggest you remove those blocks around the Iron to make it more Accessible. 
The Map may have lag issues with the amount of animations the Prismarine blocks provide however this isn't such a major issue.

Conclusion:
This map is amazing and has a unique style to what looks like a really great ocean-themed map. Although a few issues may be found in the tips above. I believe this map could get accepted

Regards,
Tiger

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
Your map has been denied, I am so sorry for the long wait. Almost all of our map development team is on leave right now and I thought this would have been taken care of: but here's your feedback.

>The layout looks very stale and I personally think that the items like the Spanky Spade are very overpowered. With edits it could be a good map but at the moment I don't see hope for it. Some of these paths also need widening.
>There's alot of void. Looks like every other map on Avicus; one main island, 2 monuments, 1 on both sides.
>eh i mean i suppose i like the layout of the map and it is evident effort was put into its making however as i have not personally gone through its chests and its contents i suppose i'd shift my judgement to be twice as demanding with DTM maps (also backed up by the fact we're apparently dialing down the acceptance rate of the aforementioned)
